about: The epistola of the formulary “Mass of the Easter Vigil” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

s01.translation: Brothers: If you have risen with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is sitting at the right hand of God. Set your mind on the things above, not on the things on earth. For you have died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God. When Christ, your life, appears, then you too will appear with Him in glory.

alignments.gloss: seek the things that are above
sitting at the right hand of God
set your mind on the things that are above

w003.explanation: Consurrexistis cum Christo means “you have risen together with Christ”.

w025.explanation: Mortui with estis forms the perfect of morior, “you have died”. Enim connects this statement to the preceding exhortation. Mortui can also describe the resulting state, “dead”.

w039.explanation: Apparuerit has future reference. English uses the present “appears” after “when”.
